verdict.rationale: Jan is itself an AI assistant/agent app, so it fills the MCP client role. The evidence only shows client-side MCP integration (connecting Jan to MCP servers, approving tool calls, the Jan Browser MCP used for its own browser automation). Nothing shows Jan running as an MCP server that other agents connect to, so this server axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
